problem_statement: V2H was preregistered before its first readout and remains locked after failing held-out predictive and emergent signed-key diagnostics. Its implementation forms independent home and away score PMFs and multiplies them, which removes shared game-level possession opportunity dependence. V2I changes that architecture before any V2I historical result is observed. V2H readout values may motivate this family change but may not be used as numerical fitting or selection targets.

game_regime.training_policy: Estimate the full game-regime distribution only from prior training-season football events. A single sampled regime is shared by both teams for each simulated game.
game_regime.independence_forbidden: Home and away possession opportunity may not be generated as independent marginal game states and multiplied after the fact.

drive_outcome_model.probability_contract: For each team and simulated possession, draw exactly one outcome state from offense-defense blended probabilities estimated only from prior training data.
drive_outcome_model.score_construction: Convert simulated possession outcomes to integer football points, sum by team, then construct the joint score distribution before any sportsbook threshold or price is applied.

architecture.dependence_policy: Dependence may arise only through shared game-level possession opportunity and explicitly football-derived training state. No market line, closing price, held-out result, signed-key target, prospective result, or capper/public signal may set or tune dependence.
architecture.key_number_policy: No explicit +/-3 or +/-7 probability target, correction factor, bonus mass, calibration target, candidate-selection objective, or post-hoc redistribution is permitted. Key-number mass must emerge from simulated football scoring mechanics.

forbidden_inputs: historical signed key-number target frequencies as a fitting or selection objective
V2H signed-key residual values as a fitting or selection objective
outer-fold outcomes during fitting or hyperparameter selection
prospective outcomes for candidate selection or tuning

fit_and_selection.selection_objective: Frozen predictive probability loss only; no key-number objective
